hero.headline: Sign up free. Invite loved ones.
hero.subline1: Referral credit goes to the inviter: up to 35% on invited customers' purchases
hero.subline2: Every order donates 1% to Il Segreto di Aladino for ethical projects

how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.step1_desc: Create your account in seconds, at no cost
how_it_works.step2_desc: One purchase of any amount makes you a Whe&Back® customer
how_it_works.step3_desc: Share your link: receive a referral reward up to 35% on their purchases
how_it_works.step4_desc: Every order funds ethical projects with Il Segreto di Aladino

referral_highlight.title: Earn by inviting
referral_highlight.desc: Referral credit does not go to the buyer, but to whoever shared the link. If you invite a new customer, you receive up to 35% of what they spend. Internal credit for future Whe&Back® purchases only.

cta_grid.register: Sign up free and start earning
cta_grid.referral: Invite friends with your unique link

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: This is the world's first true solidarity e-commerce platform. Sign up free, invite people you know and receive a referral reward up to 35% on their purchases. Every order donates 1% to Il Segreto di Aladino.

charity.title: Il Segreto di Aladino
charity.desc: 1% of all revenue is donated monthly to Il Segreto di Aladino to fund ambitious ethical projects.

cashback.title: Your Cashback
cashback.info_desc: Cashback is activated only after product delivery and the expiry of the right of withdrawal (14 days). The balance can only be used as credit for new purchases and can never be withdrawn as cash.

referral.desc: Invite unlimited friends and earn multi-level rewards

charity.desc: Every month we donate 1% of total revenue to the "Il Segreto di Aladino" Association
